security_audit.summary: The audit confirms real setup risks around hidden AI-client configuration files, npx-based MCP server execution, and Rarefriend credential handling. Most external-command detections are false positives from Markdown tool names and API examples, not shell execution. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Warn users before editing hidden MCP configuration files and document the exact command, package, and secrets that will be stored.
Pin or document the trusted @rarefriend-ai/mcp package version and recommend verifying the package source before installation.
Avoid placing secrets in shell history when possible and recommend secure environment storage with restricted file permissions.
Explain what Google Contacts data and notes are sent to Rarefriend and require explicit user consent before OAuth authorization.

semantic_findings.title: Rarefriend Credentials Stored in Setup Commands and Config
semantic_findings.description: The setup flow asks users to place the Rarefriend client ID and client secret in shell commands and MCP configuration files. This can expose secrets through shell history or readable local config files if users do not protect them.

content.value_statement: Google Contacts can lose relationship context across notes, tags, and follow-ups. This skill helps assistants search, update, tag, and enrich contacts through Rarefriend.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether the Rarefriend MCP server and Google Contacts integration are connected.
Searches contacts by name, company, email, role, tag, source, limit, and offset.
Creates, updates, and deletes contact records through Rarefriend workflows.
Creates, searches, updates, pins, and deletes relationship notes for contacts.
Adds, removes, renames, and lists tags for contact organization.
Starts Google Contacts OAuth connection and checks sync status after authorization.
limitations: Requires Rarefriend MCP credentials before the assistant tools are available.
Google Contacts sync requires browser OAuth consent and may take several minutes.
Bulk contact imports are limited to 50 contacts per call.
Calendar, Outlook, LinkedIn, reminders, and phone contacts require other Rarefriend capabilities.

use_cases.title: Prepare for a meeting
use_cases.description: Find a person, review recent notes, and surface company context before a call.

use_cases.title: Clean contact records
use_cases.description: Update emails, phone numbers, companies, roles, and locations after confirming the current profile.

use_cases.title: Segment a network
use_cases.description: Search contacts by company or role, then apply tags for investors, candidates, partners, or customers.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Contact
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search by name or company.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Sarah Lee in my Google Contacts and show her email, company, role, and contact source.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Meeting Note
prompt_templates.scenario: Record relationship context after a call.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a note to Jordan Patel saying we discussed the partner referral and follow-up timeline today.

prompt_templates.title: Tag a Contact Group
prompt_templates.scenario: Organize contacts from a company search.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find everyone I know at Sequoia, show the matches for confirmation, then tag confirmed contacts as investor.

prompt_templates.title: Import and Review Leads
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced bulk import with quality checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Import this prospect list into Rarefriend, split it into batches if needed, and tag every new contact as prospect.

output_examples.input: Who do I know at Stripe?
output_examples.output: Found three Stripe contacts. Alice Wang is from Google Contacts, Ben Ortiz was added manually, and Maya Chen is from LinkedIn sync.

output_examples.input: What did I discuss with Priya Shah?
output_examples.output: Recent notes mention the product demo, a partner introduction, and a planned follow-up next Tuesday.

output_examples.input: Tag everyone at Acme as customer.
output_examples.output: I found five Acme contacts. After confirmation, I tagged the selected contacts as customer.

best_practices: Confirm the current contact profile before updating important fields.
Mention each contact source when presenting search results.
Ask for confirmation before bulk imports, bulk tags, updates, or deletions.
anti_patterns: Do not place OAuth secrets, passwords, or private tokens in notes or prompts.
Do not import stale or unapproved contact lists.
Do not delete or overwrite contacts without explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: What does this skill connect to?
faq.answer: It connects an assistant to Rarefriend MCP workflows for Google Contacts, notes, tags, and sync status.

faq.question: Does it require Rarefriend credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. The user needs a Rarefriend client ID and client secret for the MCP server setup.

faq.question: Can it create and update contacts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create contacts and update existing contacts after reviewing the current profile.

faq.question: Can it search relationship notes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can search notes across contacts and retrieve recent relationship activity.

faq.question: Does it support bulk imports?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports bulk contact creation, with a maximum of 50 contacts per call.

faq.question: Does it manage calendars or Outlook?
faq.answer: No. Calendar, Outlook, LinkedIn, reminders, and phone contact workflows require other Rarefriend capabilities.
